body:
Founder real-time: "at some point ensure the CANNON/siege-minion feature lands clean."

Re-checked against real current code rather than trusting NORTHSTAR §20.4 (three weeks stale).
§20.4's own stated blocker -- "no structures to push" -- is resolved: real towers exist now, and
the melee/caster role split (§20.3) already shipped (S170-218).

Found a different, deeper blocker neither §20.4 nor S170-218 flagged: lane creeps (fixed 3-point
straight-line path) and towers (5 scattered Arathi-Basin-style capture nodes, S170-119) are on
geometrically unrelated systems with zero interaction code between them -- confirmed via direct
grep, not assumed. A cannon minion's whole identity is "hits towers harder"; building that on a
wave that can't structurally reach a tower would ship a reskinned melee creep with a lying name.

Documented as NORTHSTAR.md §20.5, real open design question flagged (re-anchor the lane path to
node positions vs. bolt on a separate proximity check), not resolved unilaterally -- matches this
section's own established discipline (§20.4 itself deliberately didn't force an answer on a
similar two-systems question). Once that's settled, the cannon role itself is a small, well-
scoped addition (same shape as the existing caster role) -- not built this pass, the geometry
question needs a real answer first.
title: CANNON re-investigated: real blocker found, distinct from what §20.4 named
